statement: Each pair below is byte-identical across eveningPeakGen, totalEnergyGen, eveningPeakDemand and dayPeakGen — the signature of the confirmed 2026-06-25..29 filing shift, where published days held the following day's actuals. At most one day of each pair is genuine, and the workbooks needed to rule on it are not obtainable: PGCB does not serve documents this old and no local copy is currently held. Both days of every pair are published as UNVERIFIED until a workbook decides.
method: A pair is declared here only after the four stats have been compared byte-for-byte from the archive files. Removing a pair requires the workbook: verify:source must have re-read the document and ruled which day it describes. Adding a pair is a published declaration, not a way to silence the duplicate-day check.
